toml:
# A lunar relay and navigation constellation: satellites in elliptical lunar frozen orbits
# (ELFO) plus a circular low-lunar-orbit shell, scored as a coverage and dilution-of-precision
# (DOP) map over the whole Moon for one day.
#
# The central body is the Moon: gravitational parameter, 1 737.4 km radius and spin rate come
# from the body module (the DE and IAU values cited there). The design is illustrative, not
# any agency's:
#   - an ELFO shell: 8 satellites as a Walker 8/4/1 with perilune about 720 km and apolune
#     about 7 500 km (semi-major axis 5 847.4 km, eccentricity 0.58), 57.8 deg inclination
#     and argument of perilune 90 deg, so every satellite lingers at apolune over the south
#     polar region;
#   - a circular shell: 6 satellites as a Walker 6/3/1 at 1 500 km and 85 deg.
#
# One receiver clock is shared (clock = "common"): the relay set is one system on one time
# scale. Latitude is lunar body-fixed; the map is an equirectangular projection with no land
# outline.
#
# What the run answers: where on the Moon four or more of these satellites are in view above
# a 10 deg mask, the PDOP/HDOP/VDOP/GDOP per 10 deg cell, and the share of the day with PDOP
# at or below 6. MODELLED: two-body orbits around a spherical Moon (no Earth third-body
# perturbation, which a real frozen-orbit design depends on), geometry only.

kind = "constellation-design"
body = "moon"
duration_s = 86400.0
step_s = 1800.0
mask_deg = 10.0
pdop_threshold = 6.0
grid_step_deg = 10.0
clock = "common"
track_points = 49
max_tracks = 14

[[constellation]]
name = "Lunar relay"

[[constellation.shell]]
pattern = "delta"
total = 8
planes = 4
phasing = 1
semi_major_axis_km = 5847.4
eccentricity = 0.58
inclination_deg = 57.8
argp_deg = 90.0

[[constellation.shell]]
pattern = "delta"
total = 6
planes = 3
phasing = 1
altitude_km = 1500.0
inclination_deg = 85.0
summary: constellation-design: 14 satellites (Lunar relay) around the Moon; availability 21.33% (PDOP <= 6 at 10 deg mask), worst site 0.00%, median PDOP 5.22, mean 3.2 in view; 648 grid points x 48 epochs (MODELLED)
